_notes: loc: body | head | both (one item covering both) | pair (sold per location: builds a (Body) and a (Head) item). penalty: [REF, DEX, MOVE]. effects: skill bonuses applied while equipped.

armor.rules: Built in: Anti-Smog Breathing Mask and Smart Ears. Raise or lower the visor as an Action. Lowered, it works as a Zetatech Tank Commander Headset (Going Quiet DLC), and Human Perception checks against you take -2.

armor.name: 'Nightstalker' Ballistic Mask
armor.rules: Built in: Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Smart Ears, and Smart Glasses with a Targeting Scope and TeleOptics that use no option slots and can't be removed. Raise or lower the visor as an Action. Lowered, it works as a Zetatech Tank Commander Headset, gives you the Smart Glasses' cybereye options, and Human Perception checks against you take -4.

armor.name: Gibson Battlegear Max-Helm
armor.rules: Ablation it suffers is reduced by 1 (minimum 0), and Martial Arts attacks and Special Moves don't halve its SP. Built in: Smart Ears (with Level Damper and Radio Communicator) and modified Smart Glasses with 8 cybereye option slots. Can take Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancements. Repairs 1 lost SP at the end of each day it loses none.

armor.name: Gibson Battlegear Max-Vest
armor.rules: Ablation it suffers is reduced by 1 (minimum 0), and Martial Arts attacks and Special Moves don't halve its SP. Has 1 Option Slot for External Body Cyberware that ignores installation requirements (including being an FBC and option slots), but not cyberware that grants or restores SP. While worn you can use that cyberware with no Humanity Loss and without using your own option slots. Can take Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancements. Repairs 1 lost SP at the end of each day it loses none.
A heavier Flak Armor. Priced per piece (Body or Head).
A Medium Armorjack with a lighter Armor Penalty. Priced per piece (Body or Head).
A lighter Flak Armor. Priced per piece (Body or Head).

One piece covering body and head; both are repaired together. Built in: Flashlight and Radio Communicator. The sealed helmet runs on an oxygen tank holding 30 minutes of air, refilled from the ambient air in 1 hour (spare tanks 50eb, Costly). Attached flippers remove swimming movement penalties.

armor.name: Kiroshi Tactical Optics Platform
armor.rules: Built in: Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Flashlight, Radio Communicator, and Smart Glasses with Anti-Dazzle. Raising or lowering the visor takes no Action. Lowered, your face is completely hidden and you get the Smart Glasses' cybereye options.

armor.name: Aviation Tactical Optics Platform
armor.rules: Built in: Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Flashlight, Radio Communicator, and Smart Glasses upgraded to +1 option slot, holding Anti-Dazzle, Image Enhance, and TeleOptics. Raising or lowering the visor takes no Action. Lowered, your face is completely hidden and you get the Smart Glasses' cybereye options. With the visor down and Pilot Air Vehicle 7+ or Moto Rank 2+, +2 to Pilot Air Vehicle checks.
notes: That bonus is automated while the helmet is equipped; disable its effect if you don't qualify or the visor is up.

armor.name: M-71 Combat Helmet
armor.rules: Built in, and not removable: Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors, Radio Communicator, and Smart Glasses.

armor.name: M-98A3 Enhanced Combat Helmet
armor.rules: Built in: Anti-Smog Breathing Mask; Smart Ears upgraded to +1 slot, holding Amplified Hearing, Level Dampers, and Radio Communicator; Smart Glasses upgraded to +1 slot, holding Anti-Dazzle, Low Light/Infrared/UV, and Targeting Scope; and a Zetatech Tank Commander Headset (Going Quiet DLC).

Built in: Smart Glasses upgraded to +1 option slot, holding Anti-Dazzle and Low Light/Infrared/UV. With Melee Weapon 7+ or Combat Awareness Rank 2+, +1 to Melee Weapon attacks (+2 on Aimed Shots). Repairs 1 lost SP at the end of each day it loses none.
notes: The +1 is automated while equipped; add the extra point on Aimed Shots by hand, and disable the effect if you don't qualify.

iconic.name: Arasaka "Kagami" Neo-Kabuto
iconic.rules: Iconic. Ablation it suffers is reduced by 1 (minimum 0). Built in: Smart Glasses upgraded to +1 option slot, holding Anti-Dazzle, Image Enhance, and Targeting Scope. With Melee Weapon 7+ and Evasion 7+, or Combat Awareness Rank 6+, +1 to Melee Weapon (+2 on Aimed Shots) and Evasion checks. Attacks against the wearer with Smart or Improved Smart ammo take -2. After 10 minutes without losing SP it fully repairs to SP 13. Priced at the Super Luxury minimum; Corgo lists no exact cost.
notes: The +1s are automated while equipped; add the extra point on Aimed Shots by hand, and disable the effect if you don't qualify.

gun_shields.name: Gun Shield (Medium)
gun_shields.extra: The weapon can't take Underbarrel attachments except grips (Foregrip or Angled Foregrip).

gun_shields.name: Gun Shield (Heavy)
gun_shields.extra: The weapon can't take Underbarrel attachments, it can't go on Pistols or SMGs, and it counts as Thick Cover against charged Tech Rebuilds.

gun_shield_rules: Fits a weapon's Gun Shield Mount attachment. It works as a Bulletproof Shield (mods and Tech Upgrades included), but only while that weapon is held two-handed and you haven't moved more than 4m/yds on foot this Round. Deploy or retract it as an Action, or while stowing the weapon or setting up a Bipod; deployed, the weapon can't be concealed. A destroyed Gun Shield is gone for good, and fitting a new one takes 1 minute.
enhancement_rules: Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.

enhancements.rules: Needs a DV17 Basic Tech check to install and can't be removed. The wearer can't suffer Critical Injuries from Explosives, and Explosive ammo used against them no longer counts 5s as 6s toward Critical Injuries.
Permanently turns one Fashion Jacket into the body piece of a Bodyweight Suit that looks like that fashion. The result works like a Bodyweight Suit but covers only the body, not the head.
notes: In Foundry, replace the jacket with a body-only Bodyweight Suit armor item.

enhancements.rules: Can't be combined with Reactive Armor Panels or Superheavy Plates, and the armor can't then be kitted or upgraded to look like a Fashion it doesn't already resemble.
notes: +1 SP (automated for the location the armor covers).

enhancements.rules: When installed, pick one stat; its Armor Penalty drops by 2 (minimum 0). Tech Upgrades can't reduce penalties further.
notes: The sheet uses one penalty for all three stats, so apply this by hand.

enhancements.rules: Against anything that can set you On Fire (Incendiary ammo, Flamethrowers, etc.), the damage must beat this armor's SP by 4 or more to also set you alight. The attack's normal damage and ablation still apply.

enhancements.kind: Armor Attachment (Body Armor, SP 13 or lower)
enhancements.rules: Works only while the armor has at least 1 SP. Negates the Bonus Damage of Broken Arm, Torn Muscle, and Crushed Fingers from Brawling, Martial Arts, or Melee attacks and Special Moves. Options in the arms underneath (cyber or meat) can't be used while it's worn. Can't be concealed, though most people won't recognize it.

enhancements.kind: Armor Enhancement (Body Armor, SP 8 or lower)
split: Padded: the armor's SP is no longer halved by anything except a charged Tech Rebuild.
Multilayered: the first time each Round the armor would lose SP, it loses 1 less.
Insulated: while the armor has at least 1 SP, when a single EMP effect would disable your cyberware, this enhancement is disabled instead, for the same duration.

enhancements.kind: Armor Attachment (Body Armor, SP 12 or lower)
enhancements.rules: Needs a DV17 Basic Tech check to install and can't be removed; one per armor. Then the panels are Destroyed Beyond Repair and the SP returns to normal, so uninstall this item. Tech Upgrades can't add more SP.
notes: +1 SP (automated) until the armor is next ablated.

enhancements.kind: Armor Attachment (Body/Head Armor with an Armor Penalty)
enhancements.rules: Needs a DV17 Basic Tech check to install and can't be removed. A second set adds another +3 SP, +1 to the REF penalty, and +2 to the DEX and MOVE penalties; more sets do nothing. Example: Heavy Armorjack (SP 13, -2) becomes SP 16 at -3, then SP 19 at -4 REF and -5 DEX/MOVE.
notes: +3 SP (automated) and +1 to the Armor Penalty.
Raise the armor's penalty by hand.

enhancements.kind: Armor Enhancement (Body/Head, SP 16 or lower, not Metalgear)
enhancements.rules: The armor can't then be kitted or upgraded to look like a Fashion it doesn't already resemble, and Tech Upgrades can't reduce penalties further.
notes: All of the armor's Armor Penalties drop by 1 (minimum 0); lower its penalty by hand.

shield_rules: Shield Attachments and Enhancements follow the Armor Attachment and Enhancement rules, but for Bulletproof Shields, including cyberware ones; not for vehicle Bulletproof Glass. Corgo's optional rule: a Bulletproof Shield with HP left puts its wielder in Cover and counts as a 2x2m/yds piece of Cover against Suppressive Fire, which they may share with one adjacent character.

shield_upgrades.rules: Needs a DV17 Basic Tech check to install and can't be removed. If an Explosive destroys the shield, the damage carried through to you is halved (rounded up) before your armor.
The first damage the shield takes each Round is reduced by 1, and it counts as Thick Cover against charged Tech Rebuilds.

Not for Popup Shields, and the shield can't go in one afterward. While wielding it, when a character within 2m/yds is targeted by a Ranged Attack you may put the shield in the way, even off your Turn; the shield takes the hit as normal. On your next Turn you take -1 MOVE (minimum 2) per attack blocked this way.

shield_upgrades.kind: Invented Tech Upgrade (Upgrade DV21; material cost: the shield's cost + 500eb)
notes: +5 shield HP (automated), but the shield counts as Expensive for repairs and maintenance (Breaking Your Stuff DLC).

shield_upgrades.rules: While using the shield and it has HP left, you count as having one more free hand for Grabs, Grapples, and Martial Arts Special Moves (not an extra arm).

Not for Popup Shields, and the shield can't go in one afterward. While it has HP left, it can be thrown as a Very Heavy Melee Weapon at -2 to the Athletics check. With active Speedware and a total Initiative bonus of +4 or more, it rebounds to you at the start of your next Turn; catch it without an Action if you have a free hand, otherwise it lands nearby wherever the GM decides.

Not for Popup Shields, and the shield can't go in one afterward. While it has HP left and isn't being wielded, it also works as a Skateboard (Spinning Your Wheels DLC). Can't be combined with Better Coverage or a Superdense Layer.
Needs a DV17 Basic Tech check to install and can't be removed; one per shield.
notes: +3 shield HP (automated), but the shield counts as Expensive for repairs, maintenance, and Upgrade Expertise.

shield_upgrades.rules: Needs a DV17 Basic Tech check to install and can't be removed; not for Popup Shields. Adds 2 mounts for: a Cyberscanner, Flashlight, handheld audio/video gear (Video Camera, Cybercam EX-1, Audio Recorder, Radio Scanner/Music Player, Radio Communicator, MiniMag Speakers, Pocket Amplifier), Radar Detector, small storage (Chipvault, Tech Bag, Medtech Bag; not Carryalls), or an Umbrella. Items are bought separately; mounting one is free and takes 10 minutes. They only work while the shield is wielded with HP left, and are destroyed with it if it's Destroyed Beyond Repair.
While wielded with HP left, and you haven't moved more than 4m/yds this Round, you count as having one extra free hand, usable only to help wield Non-Explosive Two-Handed Ranged Weapons.
Not for Popup Shields, and the shield can't go in one afterward. The first damage it takes each Round is reduced by 2 (4 from Explosives), and it counts as Thick Cover against charged Tech Rebuilds.
notes: While wielding it you take -1 REF, DEX, and MOVE (apply by hand), and it can never be concealed.
